title: BLR query program
statement: For each $n$ and inputs $x,y$ in the $n$-dimensional cube over the two-element field, this query-access program queries the target at the sign-embedded inputs corresponding to $x$, $y$, and $x+y$, then returns whether the decoded answers satisfy the linearity equation $f(x)+f(y)=f(x+y)$.
